part.label: Square To Round Duct Adapter
part.description: A transition adapter blending a square flange into a round duct -- the classic HVAC/ducting loft shape, and a `loft_profile` component blending two very differently-shaped cross-sections (a 4-point square and a true circle built from 4 quarter-circle arcs via `curve`, combining both the loft and curved-profile capabilities). brepjs's underlying loft algorithm corresponds mismatched vertex counts (4 square corners to 4 circle quadrant points) automatically.

components.description: Square flange (side 30mm) at the base, blending into a round duct (radius 12mm) at the top.
